I am comparing CFA and IRT. the slop of the first item in my data is negative in IRT. when i running the model with lavaan, all lambda officiants in CFA are negative except the first one. when i delete first item the sing in both analysis are the same. can any one help me to understand the problem?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: negative lambda in lavaan CFA with just one negative slope data
parts:
Are you using the default std.lv=FALSE, in which case the first item's loading is fixed to (positive) 1?  The solutions with signs switched are statistically equivalent, changing only the interpretation (direction) of the latent scale.  But you can either fix the first loading to -1 in the syntax, or you can set std.lv=TRUE to estimate all loadings and label the first loading, constraining that label to be < 0 to obtain a comparable solution to your IRT result.

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
